definitions.gloss: kelp stock; kombu broth; dashi made from kelp
definitions.explanation: A cooking stock made by soaking or simmering dried kelp (kombu) in water. One of the fundamental bases of Japanese cuisine, prized for its umami flavor.

examples.japanese: {昆布|こんぶ}だし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make miso soup with kelp stock.

examples.english: You can make kelp stock simply by soaking kombu in water.

examples.english: In Buddhist vegetarian cuisine, kelp stock is often used instead of bonito flakes.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most basic types of Japanese soup stock alongside ⟦{鰹|かつお}→鰹：06106_katsuo⟧だし (bonito stock). {昆布|こんぶ}だし provides a mild, clean umami flavor and is the preferred base for vegetarian Japanese cooking. The standard method is to soak dried kelp in cold water for several hours or briefly simmer it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昆布|こんぶ}だし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to make kelp stock)
